_comment:
Look, dismiss, WAIT, snap back, then react. Three of those four are free; the one that costs is the WAIT. The head turns to the sight at 0.30, turns away at 0.70 with a happy face - the character has looked straight at it and not understood it - and then absolutely nothing happens until 1.55. Almost a full second of dead air, broken only by a 6-thousandths idle bob so the shot does not look frozen at 12fps. The snap-back is a `parts` transform because parts SNAP and a whip-pan must not tween; the reaction that follows it is a whole-actor eased move because a body swelling in horror must.

Deliberately NOT animated: no walk, no turn-around, no clip, no arms. Only `head` and `mouth`, both ToonRigRepair guarantees. The idle bob's dy is inverted on the very next beat and the final beat zeroes dx/dy/scaleBy, because a gag that does not tidy up is permanent two scenes from where anyone is looking.

Trigger note: `mind-blown` already claims the space-form phrases 'double take' and 'does a double take'. This gag takes the HYPHENATED forms plus the whip/second-look phrasings, so neither shadows the other whatever the index order.
triggers: starts to walk away, then stops

beats._comment: oblivious. Rest pose, pleasant face - we need somewhere to fall FROM.
the FIRST look. Casual, unbothered - he has now seen the thing and it has not registered.
and away again, past neutral to the other side. Still smiling. The audience is now ahead of the character, which is the entire mechanism of the gag.
THE HOLD, 0.70 to 1.55. Nothing happens on purpose. This 6-thousandths breath is the only motion, so the pause reads as a character thinking rather than as a stalled render.
bob undone explicitly - dx/dy are offsets from the bound mark, so returning them to zero is what puts the actor back on it
THE SNAP BACK - the whole joke. A parts transform, because parts SNAP: a whip-pan that tweens is not a whip-pan. 22 degrees the other way, further than the first look went.
NOW the reaction, a beat AFTER the snap - see it, then feel it. Eased, because the body inflating is the one thing here that should be smooth.
the mouth catches up with the eyes. Head stays locked on the sight.
tidy up in one beat: rest pose back, mark back, scale back. Everything this gag touched, it returns.
